title: Email (SMTP)
description: SMTP server CertForge uses to deliver email notification channels.

username.title: Username
username.description: SMTP authentication username. Leave empty for no authentication.

password.title: Password
password.description: SMTP authentication password, used when username is set.

from.title: From address
from.description: Envelope and header From address. Required once host is set.

security.title: Security
security.description: How the SMTP connection is secured. A username requires starttls or tls.
